title: Payroll IDs
story: The central routing machine rejects every employee ID because its keypad was relocated to the payroll wing. Hal asks for each ID exactly as printed on the glass-backed trays, and every correct digit lights its own routing node. The first finished batch extends the glass bridge and a return walkway toward Mira's chute.

steps.objective: Talk to Hal beside the routing machine about the relocated keypad.
Follow the cobalt conduit east to the payroll keypad.
Enter digits 1 to 0, one mini-form each, exactly as printed on the trays.
steps.completes_when: scene_success:systems-12-guided-d1 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d2 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d3 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d4 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d5 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d6 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d7 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d8 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d9 & scene_success:systems-12-guided-d0

steps.objective: Enter the two shuffled ID lines from trays A and B.
Enter the unseen batch of five IDs.
Optional: repair the stapler with a misprinted ID tag.

dialogue.text: The routing keypad moved, and the machine rejects every employee ID. Could you enter them exactly as printed on the trays in the payroll wing?

dialogue.text: Each node lights as its digit lands. Now a shuffled set: the order is no longer the keypad's.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: The first batch is through. The bridge is extending, and a walkway comes back down to Mira's chute.

dialogue.speaker: hal
dialogue.text: All ten nodes are lit and every ID matches the trays. The cobalt line is live.

dialogue.speaker: engineer
dialogue.text: ID envelope: addressed to a department that no longer exists. Someone filed it after the name had already changed.
dialogue.cue: Engineer concerned: inspecting a tampering artifact (ID envelope)

then.text: The payroll keypad moved. Follow the cobalt conduit east to the payroll wing.
Payroll IDs entered exactly. Bridge and return walkway open.
The stapler's tag reads 4083 and it sits flat on the tray again.

state_changes.before: The machine's ten routing nodes are dark, the payroll wing is dim, the glass bridge and return walkway are retracted behind shutter plates, and Hal stares at the keypad's old place.
state_changes.after: Ten payroll nodes are lit, the cobalt conduit glows from hub to wing, the glass bridge and return walkway are extended, the payroll lamp is on and Hal is back at crouched repair.

visible_changes.note: all ten wall nodes light, one per correct digit; the payroll keypad below shows five lit (half) after digit 5 and ten (lit) after digit 0
the cobalt run lights segment by segment from the hub to the payroll wing
glass bridge to the formula room
the machine's nodes and stubs light (registered parts, no new pixels)

optional_artifact.name: ID envelope
caption: An envelope of employee IDs, addressed to a department that no longer exists.
The department was renamed after the IDs were printed.
Nobody on payroll asked for the change.

pace_copy.text: Payroll: every ID verified by route.

review_notes: 1366x768 (x4) with the keyboard inset open: Hal's briefing (12,11) and the payroll keypad (approach 32..33,14) both put avatar and target outside stage x 16-588, y 412-704; the keypad is approached from the south with the target north of the avatar, and the camera is right-clamped there. The hub route, east band and payroll wing sit right of the inset. No unavoidable conflicts.
